IDENT.title: Customization and flexible manufacturing capacity using a graphical method applied on a configurable multi-agent system

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: No formal definition; agents categorized as active (part-agents initiate actions based on goals) and passive (material/resource agents).
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: Active agents (part-agents) will initiate actions based on goals, strategies, and available resources skills to change its own or other agent states.

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: goal-oriented, rule-based, reasoning, and configurable multi-agent system (C-MAS)

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: Three types of instantiable agents coexist, part- agents, material agents, and resource agents.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: When an instance is made of an agent it starts by downloading its configuration from a database.

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: which is a general ontology aiming to be generic and applicable for all discrete manufacturing automation applications

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: The main loop selects a goal g that is possible to start and have the highest priority, priorityg, and then finds the process plan πg that solves the goal with the lowest cost.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: The agents are implemented on top of the Java Agent Development Framework (JADE) and communicate and negotiate through JADE.

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: The agents are implemented on top of the Java Agent Development Framework (JADE) and communicate and negotiate through JADE.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: The configuration includes all the properties of that specific agent and makes that agent unique in the system.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Agents hold configuration data (goals, process plans, skills, variables) downloaded from a database; resource agents track e.g. available nails/tools.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: When an instance is made of an agent it starts by downloading its configuration from a database.

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: The pick location will be provided by a skill FindStud executed on the stud buffer-agent

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: Data can also be stored in variables locally on resource agents and distributed on agent in­ terfaces.

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: Goals and variables are defined in a graphical configuration tool

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: Communication to external units will go through communication protocols such as JSON SOCKET RPC, OPC-UA, or REST depending on the connected unit.

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Abstract interfaces are mapped to resource agents during runtime when needed after a negotiation among the resource agents.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: Except that C-MAS has no supervisor the concept of SCEP is close to C-MAS.

E_LEARNING__explores_beyond_predefined_e.evidence_quote: manually created sequences of goals, one for each kind of part, and manually created process plans for solving the goals are proposed

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: A physical Plug & Produce robot-based workstation was built up to verify the flexibility in altering capacity

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: The man-time is an important factor and will directly reflect the cost of doing modifications to the system

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: Three different systems were evaluated: C-MAS, PLC, and MAS all three as a supervisor to an industrial robot.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: admits adding and removing resources to balance the manufacturing capacity without doing any digital reconfiguration or reprogramming

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: To simplify only one kind of part exists at a time and no material agents have been used

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: This test case represents an assembly process which means that the wall does not physically exist until it is assembled.

H_STANDARDS__standards_referenced.evidence_quote: Skills and process plans are stored in an execution string that consists of IEC61131–3 structure text program code

H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.value: Own C-MAS class diagram ontology of agent configuration
H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.evidence_quote: The C-MAS class diagram describing the reference architecture and ontology of the agent configuration.

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: Possibilities exist to add other communication protocols when needed.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: Part agents are active and have goals and a strategy to solve the goals by using process plans. Material agents and resource agents utilize skills on request from the part agent

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: All agents instantiated from one executable configured by data; manually authored goal charts and process plans rather than model-based plan generation; IEC 61131-3 skills; material agents.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: all agents in C-MAS are instantiated from one unified executable piece of code and the digital configuration dictates the functionality and behavior of the agents

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Claims at least one part-agent must exist; planner necessary for efficiency.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: At least one part-agent must exist, in this case, the wall.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__cites_reference_fr.evidence_quote: The concept was enlarged with control strategies, the plan of intention, and optimization-based planning [35].

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: A new agent will be instantiated when a physical component or resource is introduced to the system.
